quests.name: Names Under Ash
quests.description: The Regent burned the funeral records. Reclaim six names by laying his soldiers to rest.

quests.name: A Bell That Remembers
quests.description: Bring five Covenant ore to cast a bell that remembers the erased.

quests.name: The Ninth Funeral
quests.description: Below the northern ruins, one funeral never ended. Defeat the crypt guardian.

quests.name: The Unburied Witness
quests.description: Sen hid from the king for eighty years. Listen to his testimony.

quests.name: The Cost of Spring
quests.description: Protect the sap collectors from seven hostile echoes.

quests.name: Seeds for the Exiles
quests.description: Collect six ore crystals to shelter the children who cannot dream.

quests.name: The Root Below
quests.description: Follow the temple stairs. The ancient root guardian feeds on the valley.

quests.name: A Borrowed Childhood
quests.description: Discover why Ilyra remembers a childhood that belonged to Mara.

quests.name: The Last Honest Caravan
quests.description: Drive eight brigands from the trade road.

quests.name: Metal Without Chains
quests.description: Bring eight ore for a mint that cannot print stolen years.

quests.name: Interest on the Dead
quests.description: Under the vaults, the debt engine still calculates the price of a life.

quests.name: The Red Ledger
quests.description: Hear Cassian confess how the three kingdoms made their bargain.

npcs.name: Archivist Sen
npcs.history: Sen was the king’s chronicler. When ordered to erase his own daughter, he hid the true ledger inside a funeral bell.
npcs.secret: The first Covenant was signed willingly. Mara herself taught the Regent how to bind names.

npcs.name: Thalen
npcs.history: Thalen tended the gardens until his own child was born without dreams. Now he shelters the dreamless in the roots.
npcs.secret: Every crystal leaf contains a memory stolen from Vesper. Ilyra remembers Mara’s childhood because the garden gave it to her.

npcs.name: Engineer Ves
npcs.history: Ves designed the Golden Engine as a hospital. The council converted it into a machine for collecting years as tax.
npcs.secret: Cassian’s ledger proves every council house owes its wealth to the dead. The debt can be canceled if all shards agree.
